author: Forbes
description:
Professional race car driver, motorcycle drag racer and trailblazing athlete Destiny Spurlock shares the story of how she traded the comfort of a 2,000-square-foot home for a 200-square-foot RV while chasing her dream of racing in NASCAR.

After 17 years of setbacks and closed doors, Spurlock ultimately became the first Black woman to race in one of NASCAR’s national series. She reflects on trusting the process, embracing discomfort and staying ready for the opportunity you can’t yet see.

“Keep preparing. Keep believing. And when the opportunity arrives, be ready to move.”

author: Forbes
description:
Vivian Tu, aka Your Rich BFF, shares how she went from making financial mistakes to building a community of more than 10 million people learning to get smarter with their money.

Tu breaks down her simple “STRIP” framework for saving, paying down debt, investing, and planning for the future—and explains why financial literacy can be a pathway to freedom, choice and opportunity.

“Money is a tool, it’s a resource, it’s a skill, and it’s a muscle that you can flex and build stronger over time.”

description:
Yale psychology professor and happiness expert Laurie Santos shares three science-backed strategies for living a happier, healthier life: embrace negative emotions, practice self-compassion and protect your “time wealth.”
